parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: TypeName
parameters.description:
The type of the baseline.

>  You can call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to obtain the types of baselines from the response parameter **TypeName**.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-exposed-check-warning --lang zh --type-name weak_password --uuids 6541631a-7d47-41fd-9fef-9518113f0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeExposedCheckWarning --region cn-hangzhou --TypeName weak_password --Lang zh --Uuids '6541631a-7d47-41fd-9fef-9518113f0000'
